title: EPUB generator interpolates unescaped feed titles and authors into XHTML
reasoning: Feed titles and article authors come from external RSS/email sources. Article titles and URLs are escaped in _create_chapter, but section titles and authors are inserted raw into XHTML. A title or author containing '<', '&', or markup can produce malformed EPUB chapters or inject reader-visible HTML/scripts in readers that execute active content.
recommendation: Escape section title and author with html_escape before interpolating into XHTML, and use the escaped values consistently for page titles/headings while keeping the raw value only for EbookLib metadata if that API handles escaping itself.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included service tests do not exercise EPUB generation with malicious or XML-significant feed titles/authors; tests around PDF escaping are separate and PDFGenerator already escapes these fields.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create an EPUB with feed_title='Bad & ' and author='' then read the generated XHTML from the zip and assert escaped text appears and XML parsing succeeds.
minimumFixScope: app/services/epub_generator.py _create_section_divider and _create_chapter, plus an EPUB regression test.
